title: Divergence: forge check ADT corpus certifies exec/spec fns L0 not oracle L3 — item_subprogram drops struct/enum/recursive-enum type decls

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_adt_lower.rs::{divergence_deposit_certifies_l0_not_oracle_l3, divergence_is_circle_certifies_l0_not_oracle_l3, divergence_sum_list_certifies_l0_not_l3} demonstrate the divergence. ROOT CAUSE: check::item_subprogram (forge/src/check.rs) Item::Fn arm weaves spec_items (SpecFn) + fn_deps (Fn) but NEVER the Item::Struct/Item::Enum declarations the fn signature/body references. The Item::Struct|Enum arm's comment ('Dead-in-1a ... dies at the validator gate SpecError::UnsupportedAdt') is STALE — ADTs now lower (Stage 1c). Per-item lowering of deposit/is_circle/sum_list emits Verus referencing Account/Shape/List with NO decl woven -> verus E0425 'cannot find type' -> level_from_summary degrades to L0. Oracle (conformance/{bank_account,shape}.cert.json) says L3. Fix is the ADT-type-dependency analog of #52: weave reachable struct/enum decls (and their well_formed invariant) into item_subprogram. Note adt_lower_conformance PASSES because it lowers the WHOLE program once; the real forge-check per-item path does not.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fix: weave referenced struct/enum decls into check::item_subprogram (the #52-analog). New reachable_adt_deps collects ADT type names from the checked item + woven fn-deps (param/return Type::Named/Box-recurse, contract req/ens/dec, body StructLit/Match/Pattern::Enum/Struct/Is/Field, variant->enum resolution), then a cycle-safe fixed point follows weaved struct/enum FIELD types through the type graph (recursive Box<List> terminates). item_subprogram gains adt_deps woven FIRST (decls before fn); threaded through mutation_score/strengthen_certificate so ADT mutants still lower. Single file forge/src/check.rs (+ a clippy doc-rewrap in the test). L2/cache-key keep empty (byte-stable). #69 fold-generality NOT touched.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: RESULT (commit 310ab70): Fixed in single file forge/src/check.rs. check::item_subprogram now weaves the referenced struct/enum decls (new reachable_adt_deps: direct refs from param/return Type::Named/Box, contract req/ens/dec, body StructLit/Match/Pattern::Enum/Struct/Is/Field + variant->enum resolution; transitive cycle-safe fixed point over weaved-decl FIELD types so recursive Box<List> terminates), woven FIRST so verus has the type decl + well_formed in scope. Threaded adt_deps through mutation_score/strengthen_certificate (ADT mutants lower; no spurious 0/0 WeakContract). The 3 pinned tests PASS: deposit/is_circle/sum_list -> L3 matching the cert oracle (taut false, vac false, fx [pure], slag false). Non-ADT corpus unchanged (sum/binary_search L3, check_conformance green); adt_lower_conformance 10 pass; composition (#52) 5 pass; a boundary-caller that ALSO references an ADT composes (read_balance -> L3 to_boundary). Gauntlet: cargo test -p forge 186+ pass 0 fail; clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt --all --check PASS. The only workspace failure is thermite-lower divergence_adt_fold_generality = SEPARATE blocker #69 (fold-generality in lower.rs), not touched here.
